name: Elka Worner
office: City of Hermosa Beach, Member of the City Council

items.text: Elka Worner is a Hermosa Beach Parks and Recreation Commissioner, journalist, and small business manager. Her campaign says she founded HB SAFE, a homeless outreach program, and stopped a 50-foot development near the beach.

sentences.text: Elka Worner is a Hermosa Beach Parks and Recreation Commissioner, journalist, and small business manager.
Her campaign says she founded HB SAFE, a homeless outreach program, and stopped a 50-foot development near the beach.

items.text: She supports the half-cent sales tax on the November ballot after opposing the 2024 measure, but says the city must tighten its belt. At a forum, she said the city should recruit businesses and supported streamlining permitting. She said the city needs a long-term plan to protect services and repair aging infrastructure. She proposed multi-year budgeting, reviewing programs for results, and pursuing shared services and grants. She wants to repave neglected streets, manage e-bikes, and explore sharing facilities with Redondo Beach.
